experiment_template.research_question: Does path-balanced cumulative evidence remove duplicate-path anchoring while retaining cross-boundary source recovery?
stop_conditions: Dual terminal envelopes and the longer secret-resolution deadline are common instrument prerequisites, never treatment differences.
Every Round 22 identity runs once; failures remain in the denominator.
No task, threshold, scorer, context/output/total-token cap or branch-order change after freeze.

records.falsifier: Any projected handle lacks a matching receipt, any path exceeds two handles, more than four paths appear, ordering is nondeterministic, control receives state, scheduled span gain is below +0.05, file F1 or valid completion degrades, unknown model usage appears, or state increases cumulative model tokens.
records.mechanism: At each dispatched recycle generation, group delivered evidence by source path, retain the four most recently observed paths and the two newest distinct handles for each path, preserve chronological handle order, and label every item as observed rather than relevant. Keep objective, tools, context limits, 96K token cap and all causal pairing unchanged.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: A cumulative path-balanced evidence projection with at most two newest receipt-bound handles per path and four newest paths prevents observation frequency from becoming an accidental relevance weight, improving GLM-5.3-flash 8K ContextBench quality and completion within cumulative model input plus output tokens.

records.mechanism: When terminal submission is enabled, accept either one declared terminal tool call or a terminal stop response containing the same JSON fields, then apply the identical validation and export path. Invalid content still receives bounded exhaustive correction.

records.statement: A terminal tool call and a receipt-bound free-form JSON envelope are equivalent when both pass the same exhaustive schema and source-provenance validator.

records.mechanism: Present newly observed handles once and omit previously presented evidence at later boundaries.

stop_conditions: Do not lower thresholds or select favorable repetitions.

records.falsifier: A frozen full-denominator development round and untouched confirmation both meet every fixed quality, validity, integrity and token criterion.
records.mechanism: Model semantic interpretation and stochastic search dominate the bounded state signal.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: Deterministic evidence projection has no stable positive causal effect on GLM-5.3-flash ContextBench quality at 8K.

selection.reason: Round 20 and 21 together remain below the +0.05 scheduled span threshold, while 373 of 602 model-facing evidence entries duplicate a path inside the same presentation. Path balancing directly removes this unintentional frequency weight without discarding cumulative recovery handles. Dual terminal-envelope equivalence and a longer local secret deadline are separately evidenced common instrument prerequisites.
